title: AS2 compiler: attachMovie / duplicateMovieClip / createEmptyMovieClip built-in paths
description: These three MovieClip methods fall through to generic ActionCallMethod which works only when object reference is already resolved. In practice they need correct depth/name argument handling. Pattern-match call sites in compileCallExpr and emit correct ActionCallMethod sequence with validated arg count. Add unit tests verifying correct opcode sequences. NOTE: survey says 'built-in code-path needed' but verify first — these may already work via generic ActionCallMethod.
